pages.title: Topological Processor
pages.text: The third tier of processor, fault-tolerant by geometry. Its logic is stored in braided anyons, so no stray field or defect can cause an error. It runs quietly and never crashes, which I appreciate more than I expected.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)In the Femto Fabricator, I mounted a Topological Die on a Topological Circuit Board alongside a Quantum Processor and a Femtoscale Capacitor. Derelict stations kept some, still running.

Made in $(item)Femto Fabricator$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Assembly Lines.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Adaptive Feedback Core, Burst Observatory, Chronoplastic Gasket, Compactification Lathe, Dimensional Residue, ER=EPR Weaver, Einstein-Rosen Bridge Projector, Evolution Engine and more.
